spec.claim_summary: Buy Bitcoin only when price is more than 5% below the most recent high instead of buying every day.
assumptions: Asset is Bitcoin mapped to BTCUSDT.
Timeframe is daily from $1 every day allocation.
Direction is buying interpreted as long.
Recent high lookback is not stated so approximated by a large trailing window for highest high to date.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: $1 per day cash accumulation and DCA averaging ladder / position sizing left out; compiled as a single-entry long signal for a >5% dip with buy-and-hold.
No exit is stated so indefinite hold is approximated by a very large max_hold_bars.

evidence.quote: Don't Buy Until There's a Dip Greater Than 5% from the Most Recent High Price
Don't Buy Until There's a Dip Greater Than 5% from the Most Recent High Price

audit_majors: exit: Claim is repeated buying on every day price is >5% below the most recent high with $1/day allocation held to the end, not a one-time buy. Spec encodes no exit with max_hold_bars 3650 so test takes only the first >5% dip signal and holds, omitting all subsequent dip-day purchases and wait-in-cash dynamics. Leaving out the repeated-entry ladder changes tested returns vs DCA.
